comment: Brian VO for 'WorldCup26 Bonus - Norway: The Viking Row' (100s motivational team film). VERIFIED real facts (sources in README): the Viking Row chant — Gjallarhorn signal, drumbeat, seated synchronized rowing while shouting 'Ro!' (Norwegian for 'row') — was created by designer Ole Frøystad (Mr. Row Row) for the Oljeberget supporter club in late 2025, first performed at the March 2026 friendly vs Switzerland; Norway are at their first World Cup since 1998 (28 years); Norway beat Brazil on 5 July 2026 and Erling Haaland led the chant after the match; Ødegaard led it after the Senegal and Ivory Coast wins. No scorelines are stated anywhere. Voice: Brian clone (Higgsfield element 857b6dce-40c2-4dbb-88ef-bbab5d24892c cloned from the Lukaku-film Brian ElevenLabs lines). Chant-burst windows (32-36, 44-48, 56-60, 68-72) are deliberately VO-free so the crowd's 'RO! RO!' carries them.

lines.text: Listen. That sound is not thunder. That is Norway.
One horn. One drum. And a wall of Vikings, ready to row.
They call it the Viking Row. Ro means row. And when Norway rows, nobody rows alone.
Erling Haaland. The machine from Bryne. He does not chase history. History runs from him.
Martin Ødegaard. The captain. He sees the pass before the game even knows it exists.
Antonio Nusa. Lightning off the fjord. Blink, and he is gone.
Alexander Sørloth. The tower. When the ball rises, he is already in the sky.
Sander Berge. The engine room. Every voyage needs a man who never stops rowing.
Twenty eight years they waited. Then Norway rowed past Brazil. And Haaland led the chant himself.
So grab an oar, Norway. The longship is moving. And the whole world can hear it coming.
Pick your three teams at worldcup twenty six dot world. Free to play, just for fun, no prizes. Ro! Ro!
